NAME
    set - Set the input used by a specific machine for a specific role to a
          revision

SYNOPSIS

    confctl [global options] inputs machine set [command options] <machine> <role> <rev>

COMMAND OPTIONS
    --[no-]changelog     - (default: enabled)
    --[no-]commit        - 
    -d, --[no-]downgrade - 
    --[no-]editor        - (default: enabled)
